accept_criteria: Each cut finishes the hanging native clause at a legal complete-thought word end
keep_end_ms is one of the provided legal_cut_ms values
Leftover following speech stays independent at remainder_start_ms or is dropped when backchannel-only
Following sections are not absorbed whole the way a micro-merge would
reject_patterns: keep_end_ms jumps past a second complete idea to glue two whole segments
Cut invents words or times that are not in the lookahead transcript
Remainder opens mid-clause after a continuer with no leftover content
Whole following same-speaker section is consumed when a nearer thought-complete cut exists
